# ferx-core

> ferx is an open-source nonlinear mixed-effects (NLME) modeling engine for population pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics, written in Rust, with FOCE/FOCEI, Laplace, SAEM, IMP and Bayesian estimation, a `ferx` command-line tool and an R package (ferx-r).

Notes for language models and coding agents:

- Read "Using ferx from an agent" first. It gives the recommended loop: validate with `ferx check --json`, edit models one section at a time, fit with `--output-format json`, and judge the result from `status` and `warnings_structured`.
- A `.ferx` model file is its own DSL, not a NONMEM control stream. Do not translate `$PK` / `$ERROR` blocks from memory; follow the model file reference.
- The data file is NONMEM-format CSV (ID, TIME, DV, EVID, AMT, CMT, RATE, MDV, II, SS).
- Branch on the stable codes (`E_*` / `W_*` check codes, snake_case warning `category` tokens), never on message text.
- Every page below has a Markdown twin at the same URL with `.html` replaced by `.llms.md`. `llms-full.txt` at the site root concatenates all of them.

## Start here

- [Using ferx from an agent](https://ferx-nlme.org/ferx-core/agents.html): the machine-readable surfaces and the validate, fit, judge loop
- [Quick start](https://ferx-nlme.org/ferx-core/quick-start.html): a complete one-compartment oral model, fitted from the CLI
- [Installation](https://ferx-nlme.org/ferx-core/installation.html): building the `ferx` binary and the R package
- [Feature maturity](https://ferx-nlme.org/ferx-core/maturity.html): which features are stable, experimental or validated against NONMEM

## Model file syntax

- [Model file reference](https://ferx-nlme.org/ferx-core/model-file/index.html): the `[section]` blocks of a `.ferx` file
- [Parameters](https://ferx-nlme.org/ferx-core/model-file/parameters.html): `theta`, `omega`, `block_omega`, `sigma`, bounds and fixing
- [Individual parameters](https://ferx-nlme.org/ferx-core/model-file/individual-parameters.html): the expression language
- [Random-effect shapes](https://ferx-nlme.org/ferx-core/model-file/eta-shape.html): `boxcox` / `tdist` / `johndraper` transforms of an ETA and the `[eta_shape]` block
- [Structural model](https://ferx-nlme.org/ferx-core/model-file/structural-model.html): the analytical PK models
- [ODE models](https://ferx-nlme.org/ferx-core/model-file/ode-models.html): `[odes]` blocks and solver choice
- [Error model](https://ferx-nlme.org/ferx-core/model-file/error-model.html): additive, proportional and combined residual error
- [Covariates](https://ferx-nlme.org/ferx-core/model-file/covariates.html): reading covariates from the data
- [Fit options](https://ferx-nlme.org/ferx-core/model-file/fit-options.html): every `[fit_options]` key, including `method`
- [Data format](https://ferx-nlme.org/ferx-core/data-format.html): the NONMEM-format CSV columns

## Validate, fit and read results

- [CLI reference](https://ferx-nlme.org/ferx-core/cli.html): `ferx`, `ferx check`, `ferx summary`, the tools, and exit codes
- [Check report](https://ferx-nlme.org/ferx-core/file-formats/check-report.html): the `ferx check --json` schema and every `E_*` / `W_*` code
- [Warnings](https://ferx-nlme.org/ferx-core/warnings.html): `warnings_structured`, severities, every warning code with a typical agent response
- [Fit status](https://ferx-nlme.org/ferx-core/output.html#fit-status): `FitResult::status()` and its reasons
- [Fit JSON](https://ferx-nlme.org/ferx-core/output.html#fit-json-modelfitjson): the `--output-format json` schema, `schema_version`, `null` for non-finite values
- [Output files](https://ferx-nlme.org/ferx-core/output.html): sdtab, covtab, YAML and JSON fit files
- [The .fitrx bundle](https://ferx-nlme.org/ferx-core/file-formats/fitrx.html): the portable saved-fit format read by `ferx summary` and R

## Estimation methods

- [Estimation methods overview](https://ferx-nlme.org/ferx-core/estimation/index.html): choosing a method
- [FOCE / FOCEI](https://ferx-nlme.org/ferx-core/estimation/foce.html): the default estimator
- [SAEM](https://ferx-nlme.org/ferx-core/estimation/saem.html): stochastic approximation EM
- [Optimizers](https://ferx-nlme.org/ferx-core/estimation/optimizers.html): the outer optimizers and their stopping rules

## Examples and tools

- [Examples](https://ferx-nlme.org/ferx-core/examples/index.html): worked models with data
- [Tools](https://ferx-nlme.org/ferx-core/tools/index.html): bootstrap, covariate search, model search and other multi-fit tools

## R package

- [ferx book](https://ferx-nlme.org/ferx-book/): using ferx from R
- [ferx R reference](https://ferx-nlme.org/reference/): every R function, including `ferx_model_validate()`, `ferx_model_set_section()`, `ferx_get_warnings()` and `check_strictness()`

## Optional

- [FAQ](https://ferx-nlme.org/ferx-core/faq.html): comparisons with NONMEM and nlmixr2
- [License](https://ferx-nlme.org/ferx-core/license.html): which parts are MIT and which LGPL-3.0, `ferx --licenses`, and rebuilding with a modified ferx-search
- [Rust API](https://ferx-nlme.org/ferx-core/api/index.html): calling ferx-core as a library
- [Development](https://ferx-nlme.org/ferx-core/development/index.html): contributing to ferx-core
